title: 第15章 血脉觉醒第16章 炉子烤肉
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
女王面前整整齐齐地摆着她视若珍宝的财宝，但她的脸上依旧紧紧地皱着眉头。“要压制她体内的毒，我要么需要四级解毒药，最好是五级的，以免给她未来的修炼留下任何隐患，要么完全唤醒她的血脉。考虑到她的状况以及她隐藏得如此之深……这肯定会让我破费不少。但倘若能有一个拥有如此强大血脉的追随者，那就意味着我能够被动地压制所有可能派来追杀我的刺客。”
女王极目远眺，畅想未来，因为她已然打算打劫所有那些富有却愚蠢的家族。他们中的大多数根本就不清楚自己手中究竟握着怎样的财富，却还胆敢将它们藏起来不让人瞧见……
女王为她精心准备了必要的草药，以便拔出那深深刺入体内的箭。伤口已经严重感染，即便有了这些草药，想要愈合也需要相当漫长的时间。
然后她又准备好了灵气盔甲、武器等等，将它们一一放置在她那略显粗糙的阵法圆圈上。这个阵法能够从物品中提取能量，但效率却会大打折扣。
例如，如果在锻造时有一把注入了100点灵气的灵剑，那么这个阵法能够提取出那些灵气，然而修炼者能够使用的却仅仅只有大约十分之一，正因如此，这个阵法大多时候都不被人们所采用……除非你像女王这般富有。
“我很富有。”女王用力地点了点头。“但我大多数都用不上，因为我是灵气修炼者，把它们用在这儿反倒更好。”她兴高采烈地对着自己点了点头。“通过唤醒她的血脉，她就能活下来，好好为这位女王效力，既然我无法使用这些剑中的能量，吃了这些盔甲反而更有效率……”她摇了摇头，转身回到她的小仆兽身边。
“这会疼的……但看起来你根本动不了。”女王暗自窃笑。
女王伸出爪子，用力地按住狐狸的身体，用神识精准地控制着箭，毫不费力地将其拔了出来。
*呜咽*
艾可在“睡梦中”发出了痛苦的呜咽声，这突如其来的声音吓了女王一跳，但她还是继续手上的工作，将草药药膏和几颗碾碎的丹药小心翼翼地敷在艾可的伤口上。
“你需要一颗补血丹还有……一颗补血丹……”她深深地叹了口气，碾碎了好几颗，然后在艾可的伤口上又厚厚地敷了一层草药药膏。伤口开始发出嘶嘶的声响，所有的感染都慢慢地变成了一个个令人触目惊心的泡泡。
“我被禁止使用这种‘技术’，尽管它效果显着！”她冷哼了一声。她的这项技术确实成效非凡，但也会无情地夺走目标的能量……
[兽核：220-＞215-＞210-＞205-＞200-＞195]
她迅速启动阵法，那些装备慢慢地化为了尘土。
[兽核：195-＞196-＞191-＞192-＞187-＞188...]
一场激烈的拔河比赛就此上演，她正在全力以赴地为艾可疗伤。
“……你到底打算消耗多少？！”女王一脸的无语，因为艾可的上方又出现了一个巨大的漩涡，她再一次将一轮能量疯狂地吸入体内。“不！你敢消耗那块碎片，我警告你——”
漩涡的力量瞬间加倍，因为她的血脉找到了能量源，迫不及待地吸收着半径范围内的一切。
女王的脸上露出了苦涩的表情，在阵法上放上了几颗珍贵的灵石。“你……”她无奈地摇了摇头。她简直不敢相信这个小东西在昏迷的时候还能把她搜刮得一干二净。“你最好好好伺候我，否则我把你送进地府！”她对着那漩涡愤怒地咒骂着。
[修炼二元性]

*咆哮*
一声震耳欲聋的咆哮声如惊雷般冲击着她的身体。女王的直觉瞬间发出了强烈的警告，让她务必小心。感觉像是有什么古老而神秘的存在正在注视着她，古老到几乎已经被遗忘，但此刻却被重新唤醒。
那无形的野兽缓缓地环顾四周，让女王顿时感到呼吸困难。然后它将目光转向艾可，用那双巨大的无形红眼睛仔细地观察着她。
*咆哮*
它又一次咆哮着，一声接着一声，又一波可怕的压力如潮水般降临在这片森林之中。将那股强大的能量深深地印在艾可的身上，作为她完全觉醒的盛大庆祝！
能量漩涡渐渐地减弱，女王在心中暗自咒骂着自己当初为何要帮她。
“至少我还有……”女王茫然地环顾四周，她清楚地记得自己把戒指放在了阵法范围之外，就是为了防止阵法失控，想要吸收任何带有灵气的东西，但是……
“我的戒指呢？”她的声音颤抖着，为了积攒那枚戒指，她可是残忍地杀了200个人啊。
女王心急如焚地四处张望，突然注意到眼角有什么东西在闪闪发亮。
她这才松了一口气。“你吓死我了，我的小甜心，你可不能让这位女王担——”
她的话戛然而止，那确实是她的储物戒指，上面也确实有着她独有的印记……但为什么只有半枚戒指？？
她的脑子瞬间完全停止了运转，整整一周的辛苦工作就因为帮了这个小混蛋而付诸东流！
“不————————————————”女王在这寂静的夜里声嘶力竭地嚎叫着，一直哭到了天亮……
……
艾可在清晨时分悠悠醒来，感觉相当的神清气爽。她的身体依旧很难动弹，但情况已经没有之前那么糟糕了。
她满心好奇地查看自己的状态，结果被惊得目瞪口呆。
状态系统
她的变化实在是太大了……
艾可好奇地点击自己的状态。
[善恶（新）：400-600]
content_en:
The treasures she regarded as treasures were neatly placed in front of the queen, but she still had a tight frown on her face. "To suppress the poison in her body, I will either need a fourth-level antidote, preferably a fifth-level antidote, so as not to leave any hidden dangers for her future practice, or completely awaken her bloodline. Considering her condition and how deeply she hides it... this will definitely cost me a lot. But if I can have a follower with such a powerful bloodline, it means that I can passively suppress all assassins who may be sent to hunt me down."
The Queen looked far into the distance and imagined the future, for she was already planning to rob all those rich but stupid families. Most of them have no idea what kind of wealth they hold in their hands, but they still dare to hide it from others...
The queen carefully prepared the necessary herbs for her to pull out the arrow that had penetrated deeply into her body. The wound has been severely infected, and even with these herbs, it will take a long time to heal.
Then she prepared spiritual armor, weapons, etc., and placed them one by one on her slightly rough formation circle. This formation can extract energy from items, but the efficiency will be greatly reduced.
For example, if there is a spiritual sword infused with 100 points of spiritual energy during forging, then this formation can extract that spiritual energy, but the practitioner can only use about one-tenth of it. Because of this, this formation is not used by people most of the time...unless you are as rich as the Queen.
"I am rich." The Queen nodded vigorously. "But I don't need most of them, because I am a Reiki practitioner, and it would be better to use them here." She nodded to herself happily. "By awakening her bloodline, she can survive and serve this queen well. Since I can't use the energy in these swords, it will be more efficient to eat these armors..." She shook her head and turned back to her little servant beast.
"This is going to hurt...but it doesn't look like you can move at all." The Queen snickered to herself.
The Queen stretched out her paw, pressed the fox's body hard, controlled the arrow with precision with her consciousness, and pulled it out effortlessly.
*sob*
Aike let out a painful whimper "in his sleep". The sudden sound startled the queen, but she continued her work, carefully applying herbal ointment and a few crushed elixirs to Aike's wounds.
"You need a blood-replenishing pill and... a blood-replenishing pill..." She sighed deeply, crushed several pills, and then applied a thick layer of herbal ointment on Aike's wound. The wound began to hiss, and all the infection slowly turned into shocking bubbles.
"I'm prohibited from using this 'technique', even though it's very effective!" she snorted. Her technique is indeed very effective, but it also ruthlessly robs the target of energy...
[Beast core: 220->215->210->205->200->195]
She quickly activated the formation, and the equipment slowly turned into dust.
[Beast core: 195->196->191->192->187->188...]
A fierce tug-of-war ensued, and she was doing her best to heal Aike's injuries.
"...How much do you plan to consume?!" The Queen was speechless, because another huge vortex appeared above Echo, and she once again sucked a round of energy into her body crazily. "No! You dare to consume that fragment, I warn you-"
The power of the vortex instantly doubled as her blood found its source of energy and eagerly absorbed everything within its radius.
The queen had a bitter expression on her face and placed a few precious spiritual stones on the formation. "You..." She shook her head helplesslyShake his head. She couldn't believe that this little thing could plunder her completely while she was unconscious. "You'd better serve me well, or I'll send you to the underworld!" She cursed angrily at the vortex.
[Cultivation of duality]
*roar*
A deafening roar struck her body like thunder. The Queen's intuition immediately issued a strong warning, telling her to be careful. It felt like some ancient and mysterious being was watching her, so ancient that it had been almost forgotten, but was being reawakened at this moment.
The invisible beast looked around slowly, making the queen suddenly find it difficult to breathe. Then it turned its gaze to Echo, observing her carefully with its huge invisible red eyes.
*roar*
It roared again, one after another, and another wave of terrible pressure descended on the forest like a tide. Imprint that powerful energy deeply into Aike's body as a grand celebration of her complete awakening!
The energy vortex gradually weakened, and the queen secretly cursed in her heart why she had to help her in the first place.
"At least I still have..." The Queen looked around blankly. She clearly remembered that she put the ring outside the range of the formation, just to prevent the formation from getting out of control and absorbing anything with spiritual energy, but...
"Where is my ring?" Her voice trembled. In order to accumulate that ring, she brutally killed 200 people.
The Queen looked around anxiously, and suddenly noticed something shining in the corner of her eye.
She breathed a sigh of relief. "You scared me to death, my little sweetheart, you can't let this queen bear-"
Her words stopped abruptly. It was indeed her storage ring, and it did have her unique mark on it... But why was there only half a ring? ?
Her brain suddenly stopped functioning completely, and a whole week of hard work was wasted just because she helped this little bastard!
"No————————————————" The queen howled at the top of her lungs in the silent night, crying until dawn...
…
Ai Ke woke up in the early morning, feeling quite refreshed. It was still difficult for her to move, but it wasn't as bad as before.
She curiously checked her status and was stunned.
state system
She has changed so much...
Aike clicked on his status curiously.
[Good and Evil (New): 400-600]
